inventory.text: Long Term Care Employers Train and Gain: Build Your CNA Pipeline with Earn and Learn Financial Awards CNAP's Earn and Learn program helps you train CNAs and gain a stronger, more stable workforce. Get ​paid​​ ​for training — whether your facility conducts training on-site or partners with an approved provider. Learn How the Program Works Talk to a Program Advisor Earn and Learn Program Train CNAs, Gain $2,000 Per Certified CNA Even if your Skilled Nursing Facility (SNF) isn’t approved to train on-site, you can still participate through partnerships with local training programs. We’ll help connect you to the right training path. SNFs receive funding for each CNA who completes training and certification through the Earn and Learn program. This helps cover training costs while improving retention and quality of care. Lower CNA recruitment costs Hire and retain quality CNAs post-certification Improve quality-of-care Start Building Your Workforce Now! Want to receive training funding for your facility? Talk to a Program Advisor Zane Hatfield CNAP Program Advisor Being Part of the Program Choose the Training Path that Works for You Train and Gain with the Earn and Learn Program — every SNF has a way to participate. Whether you’re alrea dy approved to train CNAs or prefer to partner with a provi der. Each option ​ provides financial awards to ​ help ​ ​ you d evelop talent and strengthen your team. Facility-Based NATP Become a facility-based CNA school and connect your CNAs with residents from day one. Alternative NATP Partner with a CNA training provider for a hybrid online and in facility experience. Community-Based Partnership Work with a local NATP to train new CNAs and grow your workforce. Explore Common Questions Facility Benefits Advantages of Earn and Learn Financial Awards Access Earn and Learn funding to grow your workforce, remove financial barriers for participants, and invest in long-term care excellence. Recruit, Train, Retain (RTR) Use Earn and Learn resources to strengthen your ability to recruit new talent, provide hands-on training, and retain skilled, committed healthcare professionals. Enhanced Quality Care By training CNAs, you can elevate the quality-of-care provided to residents by developing a skilled and knowledgeable clinical workforce. Employer Recognition Position your organization as an employer committed to investing in the development and growth of your frontline workers, fostering a positive and supportive workplace culture. Continuous Improvement Engage in ongoing improvement as Earn and Learn provides tools, best practices, and educational resources to support your organization's performance and workforce development goals. Earn and Learn Application Guide Facilities that provide Earn and Learn programs in conjunction with a CDPH approved NATP will receive $2,000 per certified CNA. Unlimited each year while annual funds are available. SNFs that volunteer to host clinical rotations for CNA students also qualify for a $25 per student award through CNAP, with eligibility retroactive to January 1, 2023. The Earn and Learn awards require the submission of supporting documentation. To ensure a smooth and timely review, gather all required documents before submitting your application and email them to CNAP at the time of submission. Ready to Train and Gain? Talk to a program advisor who can walk you through the application process and answer your questions. Getting started is simple: Connect with a program advisor to discuss your facility’s training approach Complete the CNAP Financial Awards Application form Your advisor will guide you through the documentation needed for your facility type Submit your application and supporting documents to CNAPinfo@cahf.org Three facility types can participate in Earn and Learn. Not sure which applies to you? Our program advisors can help you: Determine which training pathway works best for your facility Understand what documentation you’ll need Connect with approved training partners in your area Navigate the application process step-by-step Whether you’re already a CDPH-approved training facility or looking to partner with a local program, we’re here to help make it work. Download Application Packet Train and Gain Form Template SNF Contact What type of SNF are you? - Select - Independent/Multi SNF/Corporation Alternative SNF Contact Not Sure Full Name Email Address Which award(s) are you interested in applying for? Earn and Learn 2nd DSD First Time NATP Clinical Rotations CUSP Not Sure/Need Guidance Previous Next Facility Name Address Facility Address Line 1 Facility Address Line 2 Facility City Facility Zip Code Previous Next Counties Served Parent Company (if any) Previous Submit Connect with a Program Advisor Contact us at zhatfield@cahf.org or fill out the form to connect with an advisor who can answer your questions and help you start the process of receiving training funding for your facility. Testimonials Oak River Rehab “While the application process at first seemed a bit daunting, once the CNAP team walked me through everything, it was super easy to submit all of the required documents. From there on out, we only saw great benefits through our relationship with CNAP, including the care that our Earn and Learn CNA graduates are now delivering in our facility.” Chad Kanow , Assistant Administrator , Oak River Rehab Kern Valley “CNAP awards have allowed us to continue to offer this program with a reduced demand on facilities resources! It is very easy to work with the CNAP staff! The application process is simple, they explain everything, and it is well organized. We feel incredibly supported!” Brandy Arana, Administrator and NATP Coordinator, Kern Valley Crystal Ridge Care Center "Without knowing the process, the CNAP application can seem a bit daunting, but once you work with the CNAP team, the process is really streamlined, not complicated at all. The staff is so supportive." - Daenen Miller, Administrator, Crystal Ridge Care Center
